coordinateSystem: ICRF / IAU_JULIET, NAIF body 711; east-positive body longitude
qualification: PCK00011 IAU periodic terms evaluated at the prepared scene epoch. Runtime advances the linear prime meridian and holds the small pole/periodic correction at that epoch; this is a display approximation, not a complete long-term nutation ephemeris. PCK obsolete spherical radii are not used for shape.
